notes.title: Try out Wedding Designer Prologue on Steam
notes.content:
Hello, SPECIALIST'S VENGEANCE community!

There is still some time to spent before SPECIALIST'S VENGEANCE release. Development is going amazing, but we need some more time time to make this game as awesome, as you expect.

In the meantime, we invite you to play our just released Prologue version of Wedding Designer.

[b][i]Wedding Designer Prologue is a simulator of an agency that will organize a large party on an old, ruined farm. Unleash your creativity, use the right equipment, prepare a place, use what you find. Steer the tractor if you want to.[/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405810/Wedding_Designer_Prologue/

[previewyoutube=FYDUXCf8MN8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Get to your testing ground.
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0fpVy0F/12.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello SPECIALIST'S VENGEANCE community![/h2]

Today we would like to show you some new recordings from the current Specialist's Vengeance development status.

Currently, we are working on improving demolishing visuals and functionality. It takes a lot of tests to get to perfection, so our dummies don't have an easy life.

In the game, you will also be able to test your explosives before you go do what you have to do. 
[b]
Get to your testing ground, demolish a couple of cars, blow up some dummies, test what suits you![/b]

notes.title: DevLog #1 - Let`s prepere the bomb
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39107438/1bba657caf4761c766e4c9033ce9c94ed969433e.gif[/img]

It's time for the first [b]Specialist's Vengeance[/b] developement update. We would like to talk about crème de la crème - Bombs.

In [b]Specialist's Vengeance[/b], you will get into your hands a massive arsenal of various explosives that your enemies will taste. 

But before you test and, finally, use your bombs, you have to build it in your workshop. 

Olivia`s special effects specialist knowledge will help you for sure
